name: Órbita MCP
description: Property Content Engine MCP server. Manages real-estate property ingestion, AI video rendering, 3D tours, public microsites, and analytics. 11 tools aligned with Órbita REST API.

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: List all properties with photos, plans, and render jobs.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get full property detail by ID (photos + latest plan + 6 jobs).

tools.name: create_property
tools.description: Create a new property {name, address, tone}.

tools.name: delete_property
tools.description: Delete a property and remove its storage directory.

tools.name: ingest_photos
tools.description: Ingest photos via files|zip|url mode. Dedupes by sha-256, normalizes EXIF, generates thumbnails.

tools.name: analyze_property
tools.description: Run AI vision analysis (GLM-4.5v) on property photos. Detects rooms, objects, light, style.

tools.name: direct_property
tools.description: Run AI Director (LLM) to generate a shot plan with camera moves, durations, captions, tone.

tools.name: start_render
tools.description: Enqueue render job. Resolutions 720/1080, quality speed/quality. Format 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get 14-day analytics: daily views + byRef (qr/instagram/whatsapp) + counts per event.
